facts.fact: The AfDB appraisal report of October 2022 cites the Cabo Verde Digital Agenda 2019-21, under which the Government set strategies for connectivity, capacity building, service provision and governance, as a strategy of the period 2019-2021; the report is dated after that period and does not say whether a successor exists (the document's published date is used for the as-at).

systems.tiers: Connectivity, capacity building, service provision and governance
The report says it aims to harmonise the public policies that define the country's digital transformation
Digital services and innovation named as one of seven strategic sectors
